jati: Shadav-Shadav (Pa is varja — omitted in both directions)
time_of_day: Pre-dawn — brahma muhurta, before sunrise (4am to 6am)
aaroh: S r G M M# d N S'
avaroh: S' N d M# M G r S
notes_used: Re komal, Ga SHUDDH, both Ma shuddh AND Ma teevra (this dual Madhyam is rare and defining), Dha KOMAL, Ni SHUDDH. Pa is completely absent.
characteristic_pakad: S r G M M# G r S
emotional_resonance: feeling stuck between night and day
grief that surfaces in the early hours
insomnia that has lasted through to dawn
needing to centre before a very important day
a sense of longing most acute at dawn
therapy_note: Lalit is one of the rarest and most complex raags — the raag of brahma muhurta, the sacred hour before dawn when the world is in complete stillness. The combination of komal Re, shuddh Ga, both Madhyams, komal Dha, and the absence of Pa creates a sound that is simultaneously ancient and urgent, like a question asked in the dark before the answer arrives with sunrise.

bollywood_references.title: Woh Subah Kabhi Toh Aayegi
bollywood_references.note: Contains the pre-dawn longing quality characteristic of Lalit — not a strict classical treatment

notes_for_vocalist: Three critical corrections: Ga is SHUDDH (not komal), Dha is KOMAL (not shuddh), Ni is SHUDDH (not komal). The dual Madhyam (both Ma and Ma# in the same raag) is the most distinctive feature — the shuddh Ma is used in lower movements, the teevra Ma in ascending phrases. Pa is strictly forbidden. This is an advanced raag requiring complete stillness and presence — best practiced between 4am and 6am.
common_mistakes: Treating Ga as komal — Lalit has SHUDDH Ga
Treating Dha as shuddh — Dha is KOMAL in Lalit
Treating Ni as komal — Ni is SHUDDH in Lalit
Using only one Madhyam — the movement between shuddh Ma and teevra Ma is essential
Including Pa — it is strictly forbidden
variant_notes: Lalit is rarely heard in Bollywood due to its complexity and specialised time constraint. Gharana variations exist in how the two Madhyams are balanced. Some treat teevra Ma as more prominent, others as approximately equal.
